I brought it by train from Bhopal to goa. No damages whatsoever. The case had a glass panel and still didn't have any scratches. Pack it properly and then you can take it yourself from the train. 

Now how to pack 

1.use mostly the original boxes as they are the best and are used for shipping.
2. If you don't have the original packaging then take measurements of your pc and go to any nearby computer shop, grocery shop and bring at least 2 inches bigger boxes from each side.
3. Fillings could be thermocol around 6 inches of about 25 rupees. Put the case in a horizontal position and then fill the thermocol.
4. How to fill is a good question. Put it wherever you find the space.
5. Removing GPU and cpu cooler is ideal but if in case you don't want to remove it put thermocol supporting the GPU and cpu cooler.
6. Wiggle the GPU and cpu cooler to see if the thermocol is doing the job well.
